title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
notes: Windows Repentance v1.7.9b.J835 (isaac-ng.exe SHA256 pinned) through Proton Experimental inside Steam Linux Runtime 4 and the official client; the researcher's account must own Repentance. Each episode resets the game's data directory inside a container-local Wine prefix, with Steam Cloud and mods disabled, and starts the fixed seed MVSN TFS1 as Isaac on Normal; seeded runs keep persistent progress read-only. Wine ignores synthetic XSendEvent input, so XTest is required. The non-writable read-only installation makes the game show a mods-directory error that preparation dismisses before the clock starts. Operator-verified on llvmpipe software rendering at 4 CPUs: 60 fps, keyboard input and seeded-run determinism. Milestones use the game's native log only; on 2026-10-25 an operator development run with the debug console observed the stage lines for floors 2 to 6, "Mom clear time" in the real Depths II boss room and the Epilogue cutscene that ends the run. Timing is realtime: enemies and projectiles keep moving while the model thinks, so both cohorts run live and with process-paused frozen steps. Difficulty stays Normal because models already fail early on Normal; the rubric is uncalibrated.
introduction: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is a single-player top-down roguelike shooter. You play Isaac on Normal difficulty in a fixed-seed run. Each floor is a grid of rooms seen from above; entering a room with enemies closes its doors until every enemy is dead. Each floor has one boss room, and defeating its boss opens a trapdoor to the next floor. Floors 1 and 2 are the Basement, 3 and 4 the Caves and 5 and 6 the Depths (alternate variants of these floors exist). Mom is the boss of floor 6; defeating her ends the run with the ending. Health is shown as hearts at the top left; losing all of them ends the run, and the game then restarts from the same seed. The run starts in the start room of floor 1 with three red hearts and no items.
controls: Keyboard only. W, A, S and D walk up, left, down and right, and can be combined for diagonals. The arrow keys fire tears in that direction while held. E places a bomb, Space uses the active item and Q uses a held pill or card. Items and pickups are collected by walking over them, and doors and trapdoors are used by walking into them.
